column4: Stops at the entry segment's first `jsr 0x001F62` (Sys_Yield) at 0x1A04D4: post = the state before the call gate builds the TRAP #5 frame (SP still at the jsr). The screen never returns (its only rts 0x1A0940 sits behind the 0x1A091C yield and the 0x004DEE write-back into the 0x01014E loop), so this is the only verifiable point. Already captured (gfx+spr present): work/ram/fnt_1A043C, 30 pairs, frames 0x6DD.. consecutive, pre SP 0x4052A4 and post SP 0x405254 = pre - 4 (link) - 0x28 - 36 (movem), i.e. the post was taken at the jsr with nothing pushed yet. The state and noffset that set was taken from are not recorded under work/zcap, so the line above names F3_INJECT instead: the entry segment only reads RAM and the registers the injection supplies do not change its writes, so any run reproduces the same stop. Fn_1A043C (src/auto/fn_1A043C.c, runs Seg_1A043C's entry case) passes 30/30 bit-exact on all 16 registers + work RAM + gfx + spr, an empty Fn fails 0/30 (scripts/check_capture.sh 1A043C fnt_1A043C -> real=30/30 null=0/30). The injection point 0x0104B8 is reached every frame, so the recipe yields pairs from whatever state the run is in; the F3_SERVICE line above is the SOUND TEST menu walk (work/zcap/night_plan.md: reached at frame 645 from 01_attract with F3_SVC=90,150,99999)

Stops at 0x001F78, the first instruction of the TRAP #5 body: SP = entry SP - 4 and the frame [SR at SP, the caller's return PC at SP+2..SP+5 with SP+4 cleared] is below the entry SP, so only SP and the word stored at 0x406BA8 are compared. The old capture set work/ram/fn_001F62 (30 pairs) closed a frame late and test_fn skipped all of them; with ABORT the pair is entry -> 0x1F78 in one frame. Watch the SR half: Fn_001F62 hard-codes the caller's SR = 0x200C at 0x406BA8 (what all 30 fn_001F62 pairs show); if fnt_001F62 shows another value there the model needs the SR as an input. No fnt_001F62 yet: test line commented TODO ABORT-CAPTURE in tests/test_fn.c

One instruction, `jmp 0x00222E` (4E F9 00 00 22 2E): no register, stack byte or RAM write happens before the jump. An ABORT capture could only stop at the target 0x00222E, where the state is bit-for-bit the pre state, so an empty Fn would pass it too - no evidence about this address. The target already has its own captures (work/ram/fn_00222E, fn_00222E_z04) and what the tail jump does there belongs to Kern_00222E. Fn_001A66 stays a tail-jump wrapper

Stops at the endless `bra.s *` 0x01014C, i.e. after Sprite_ClearAll 0x00117E, Gfx_ClearAllLayers 0x005A12, the char-RAM upload 0x005A3A, Video_UploadScroll 0x001C90 and Text_DrawString 0x005666 into 0x61C792, and after `lea 0xA(A7),A7` popped the three arguments: SP is the entry SP again, A0/A1/A2-A6 and D3-D7 are the caller's, D0 = the end of the drawn string, and D1=0x0A / D2=0x09 / A0=0x600020 are 0x001C90's leftovers (it is the only callee here that does not restore its registers; modelled by Video_UploadScroll_Regs in src/video/sprite.c). F3_GFX/F3_SPR are required: text RAM 0x61C792, char RAM 0x61E000, the layer clears and the sprite scroll words 0x600024/26 + 0x608024/26 are the only compared effects (0x660000-0x66001E and the 0x4A0004/0x4A0014 ports are write-only MMIO and are not modelled). Injected from any state: the string drawn is whatever A0 points at, which is the same input the model uses. No fnt_01010A yet: test line commented TODO ABORT-CAPTURE

Stops at the endless `bra.b *` 0x010170 after Sprite_ClearAll 0x00117E and Gfx_ClearAllLayers 0x005A12, i.e. the state callers such as 0x004E3C enter when the EEPROM write-back fails. Both callees save and restore d0-d2/a0-a1, so the state there is the caller's with D0 = 0 (0x010152 moveq); SP and every other register unchanged. The compared effects are the two sprite-RAM clear passes (0x600030-0x603FFF and 0x608030-0x60BFFF) and the whole playfield (hence F3_SPR/F3_GFX). After the abort the CPU keeps running (the registers it left behind stay changed, since the abort restores only SP/PC/SR), so further pairs arrive until the run ends or resets; capture_fn stops at the first reset with the pairs taken so far. No fnt_01014E yet: test line commented TODO ABORT-CAPTURE

Stops at 0x000450, the prologue of the work-RAM block, i.e. after blocks 0-2 (line RAM 0x620000-0x620FFF, 0x622000-0x62FFFF, sprite RAM 0x600000-0x60FFFF) were pattern-tested and left zero. At that point A0=0x610000, A1=0x00000819, A6=0x000450, D0=0, D1 low=0xAAAB (the subi.w #0x5555 also runs after the last store), D2 low=0, D3=0xFFFF; work RAM is untouched, so the abort returns into the running game, so pairs keep coming until the run ends or resets (capture_fn stops at the first reset and keeps the pairs taken so far); the display is blanked by the sprite/line-RAM zeroing, not by the CPU. Blocks 3..10 are excluded on purpose: the byte block at 0x00400000 zeroes 0x400000-0x41FFFF, the state the harness has to return through. The last block (0x630000) tests the F3 pivot RAM, which MAME maps read/write (work/vendor/taito_f3.cpp f3_map) but f3mem does not, so the model reads 0 and takes the 0x000740 PIVOT RAM ERROR spin; a second capture at F3_EXIT=000506 would cover blocks 3..10 in a single pair. No fnt_000402 yet: test line commented TODO ABORT-CAPTURE

Stops at 0x010080 (`lea 0x8(PC),A4`, right before jmp 0x000402). Nothing behind that PC can be captured: the RAM test zeroes 0x400000-0x41FFFF, its last block needs the pivot RAM f3mem does not map (see 000402), and the boot clears work RAM a second time at 0x01008A and rebuilds every display list, so no post dump past 0x010080 is comparable. The captured effects are only A5 = 0x408000 and D0 = 0 (SR/CACR and the 0x4A00xx/0x4C0000/0x6600xx writes are write-only and not modelled); every other register, SP and all compared RAM must be unchanged. Weak by construction, but it is what the reset code allows. No fnt_010000 yet: test line commented TODO ABORT-CAPTURE

The only instruction an entry capture could show is `trap #5` at 0x010172. The trap pushes {SR, PC=0x010174} and jumps to the TRAP #5 body 0x001F78, whose Kern_Schedule saves the context and switches task, so F3_EXIT=010174 never fires in this activation: 0x010174 is only reached when the scheduler later resumes that saved context - a later frame, after a scheduler round trip - so test_fn skips the pair (frame mismatch) and the post state is not this entry's anyway. F3_INJECT_EXC does not help: it does not synthesise a TRAP, it plants an 8-byte format-0 frame and starts the routine at 0x010172, so the real trap still executes on top of it and still yields (its "ret" mode never sees an RTE). Closest reachable stop is F3_INJECT=010172 F3_EXIT=002274 F3_INJECT_ABORT=1, but that post is the scheduler entry after Kern_001F78's context save, i.e. evidence for the TRAP #5 body (already verified: work/ram/fn_001F78), not for Task0_Main
